Seven programmes · a sector in focus 3–4 times a year

Programmes

NDD starts as a district without walls: a calendar of programmes held in member studios and partner venues across Abuja. Seven programmes, each bringing at least three pillars together.

See the 2027 calendarHow the year works ↓

All programmes

01

NDD Open Studios

A walking or driving trail through member studios and showrooms, with a printed and digital map.

How often
Monthly or every two months
Starting
First trail: February 2027
02

NDD Salon

Intimate talk-and-dinner evenings pairing an architect, a fashion designer and a maker on one theme, such as "Indigo: from dye pit to facade".

How often
Monthly
Starting
First Salon: January 2027
03

NDD Craft Exchange

Residencies and commissions pairing heritage artisans with contemporary designers. The results are exhibited and sold.

How often
Twice a year
Starting
Announced February 2027
04

NDD Material Library

A growing collection of Nigerian materials, finishes and textiles for architects and interior designers to specify.

How often
Ongoing
Starting
Starts as a pop-up in 2027
05

NDD Pop-up Showroom

A curated, shoppable exhibition of member work in a borrowed or partner space.

How often
Every quarter
Starting
First showroom: March 2027
06

NDD Week

The flagship annual festival: exhibitions, talks, open studios, a fashion presentation and international guests.

How often
Every year
Starting
First edition: late 2027
07

NDD Journal

Our editorial platform documenting members and Nigerian design.

How often
Monthly online, plus an annual print edition
Starting
Issue 1: March 2027

One sector per quarter

3–4 times a year

Three or four times a year, roughly once a quarter, NDD's calendar puts one of the six sectors in focus. Sectors that don't get a turn one year lead the next.

Host, sponsor or partner

Bring a programme to your space.

Members host Open Studios stops and Salons in their own studios. Partners lend venues and sponsor programmes, especially NDD Week.

NDD brings together fashion, architecture, interiors, art and product design to showcase Nigerian creativity, support collaboration and connect creative businesses with opportunities.
